prefix + format string.sql:
COPY INTO DB.RAW.T
FROM @ST/orders/20260701/
FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' FIELD_DELIMITER = ',')

files list + named format.sql:
COPY INTO DB.RAW.T
FROM @ST
FILES = ('a.csv', 'b.csv')
FILE_FORMAT = (FORMAT_NAME = 'MYFMT')

pattern + copy options.sql:
COPY INTO DB.RAW.T
FROM @ST
PATTERN = '.*[.]csv'
FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')
ON_ERROR = CONTINUE

validation mode.sql:
COPY INTO DB.RAW.T
FROM @ST/p/
FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'JSON')
VALIDATION_MODE = RETURN_ERRORS
